HISD Accordion

The accordion is a stacked set of disclosures. Each header is a native <button aria-expanded aria-controls> inside a heading; each panel is a role="region" labelled by its header. The chevron rotates over --duration-fast; collapsed panels are hidden. The first set allows multiple panels open at once; the second is single-open (exclusive). The right column is forced to data-theme="dark" — the component inherits dark purely through semantic tokens, with no component-specific dark CSS. Keyboard: Enter/Space toggle a header; Arrow Up/Down move between headers; Home/End jump to first/last.

Light theme

Multi-open · collapsed, expanded & disabled

Start at the online enrollment portal, choose your zoned campus, and upload proof of residency. (Expanded by default.)

Comprobante de domicilio, acta de nacimiento y registro de vacunas. (Panel colapsado por defecto.)

This section is disabled in the demo to show the disabled state.

Single-open (exclusive)

Students living more than two miles from their zoned campus qualify for transportation.

Free breakfast and lunch are available to all enrolled students at participating campuses.

Programs run until 6 p.m. on regular school days; register through your campus front office.

Copy-paste snippet

<div class="hisd-accordion" data-accordion>        <!-- add data-accordion-single for exclusive -->
  <div class="hisd-accordion__item">
    <h3 class="hisd-accordion__heading">
      <button type="button" class="hisd-accordion__trigger"
              id="acc-1-trigger" aria-controls="acc-1-panel" aria-expanded="true">
        <span class="hisd-accordion__label">How do I enroll my child?</span>
        <span class="hisd-accordion__chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      </button>
    </h3>
    <div class="hisd-accordion__panel" role="region" id="acc-1-panel"
         aria-labelledby="acc-1-trigger">
      Panel content…
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="hisd-accordion__item">
    <h3 class="hisd-accordion__heading">
      <button type="button" class="hisd-accordion__trigger"
              id="acc-2-trigger" aria-controls="acc-2-panel" aria-expanded="false">
        <span class="hisd-accordion__label">¿Qué documentos necesito?</span>
        <span class="hisd-accordion__chevron" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      </button>
    </h3>
    <div class="hisd-accordion__panel" role="region" id="acc-2-panel"
         aria-labelledby="acc-2-trigger" hidden>
      Panel content…
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Disclosure pattern (WAI-ARIA APG "Accordion"):
     • Each header is a <button aria-expanded aria-controls=[panel-id]> inside
       a heading; each panel is role="region" aria-labelledby=[trigger-id].
     • Collapsed panels carry the `hidden` attribute.
     • Enter/Space toggle; Arrow Up/Down move between headers; Home/End jump
       to first/last. The chevron rotates over --duration-fast.
     • Add data-accordion-single for single-open (exclusive) behavior.
     Wire with the script in this demo. -->
